name: Télé API
description: Endpoints and a page for the Télé Android TV player, open to standard users: channels with the current program in one call, free provider connections, playback sessions, and the audio and subtitle languages of the VOD measured with ffprobe.
author: Télé

fields.label: Endpoints
fields.description: Served under /api/tele/v1/ with the API key of any standard user. Each user only sees their own channels and sessions. Admins: the Télé page is at /api/tele/ui/ (also in the actions).

fields.label: Let players close their own sessions
fields.help_text: Télé closes the preview or the channel it left open before opening another one, so a TV never holds two provider connections.

fields.label: Sync the TVs of a user
fields.help_text: Favorites, movie and episode positions, my list, collections and reminders, shared by the Télé TVs signed in with the same Dispatcharr user (kept in the data folder, one file per user).

fields.label: Requests per minute and user
fields.help_text: Beyond, the Télé endpoints answer 429 for the rest of the minute. 0: no limit. Admins are not limited.

fields.label: Show the provider account names to players
fields.help_text: Off: standard users only get the numbers of free connections; admins always see the names.

fields.label: Sort the streams of the channels
fields.help_text: Every 30 minutes, the streams of each channel enabled in a channel profile are put in order: the available ones first (not failing lately, provider account active, still in the playlist), then the best quality (the resolution Dispatcharr measured, else the one of the name). A channel being watched is sorted at the next run. Also from the Télé page.

fields.label: Message for the TVs
fields.help_text: Shown on the home screen of the Télé TVs (read again every 5 minutes); empty: no message. 500 characters at most.

fields.label: VOD languages
fields.description: ffprobe reads the audio and subtitle tracks of one file per category. A probe uses a real provider connection: it only starts when one is free, one at a time, and stops at once when a viewer needs the connection.

fields.label: Keep the provider connection of a paused movie (minutes)
fields.help_text: A movie or an episode paused on a Télé TV keeps its provider connection this long, so nobody takes it before the resume (Dispatcharr frees it as soon as the paused stream closes). Given back at the resume, when the TV leaves the player, or after this time. 0: off.

fields.label: Load the episodes of the series being watched in advance
fields.help_text: Every 10 minutes, the episodes of up to 12 series watched lately or popular on the server are loaded from the provider (once a day per series), so their sheet opens at once on the TVs. Uses no stream connection.

fields.label: Measure VOD languages with ffprobe
fields.help_text: Runs every 10 minutes in the background; the results are kept in the Dispatcharr data folder.

fields.label: Categories to probe
fields.help_text: Uncertain: nothing about the language (NETFLIX, Action), MULTI, MULTI-SUB, VOST, VO or Arabic.

fields.label: Free connections to keep
fields.help_text: On the provider profile, before a probe starts.

fields.label: Pause between two probes (seconds)
fields.help_text: One probe at a time on the server.

fields.label: TMDB
fields.description: With a TMDB key (set on the Télé page, never in these settings, which every user can read), the plugin finds the TMDB id of the movies and series Dispatcharr has none for: Télé groups the same title listed under different names as one, with all its versions.

fields.label: Find the missing TMDB ids
fields.help_text: In the background, a few hundred titles every 10 minutes.

fields.label: TMDB automatic match from (%)
fields.help_text: 50 to 99. The confidence a search result needs to be kept: likeness of the title and of the year. Lower: more titles matched, more mistakes. The candidates below stay on the Télé page, to accept one by one or from a confidence.

actions.label: Télé page: /api/tele/ui/
actions.description: The dedicated page for admins (VOD groups, languages, TMDB, sessions, TVs, statistics): add /api/tele/ui/ to the address of this Dispatcharr, e.g. http://dispatcharr:9191/api/tele/ui/. The button gives the full link.

actions.label: Status
actions.description: Routes of this worker, open sessions, VOD languages measured and failed.

actions.label: Reload in every worker
actions.description: Loads this version of the plugin in every Dispatcharr process, without restarting Dispatcharr (after an import or an update).

actions.label: Stream health
actions.description: Counts the recent failures of each provider stream from the Dispatcharr events (errors, failovers, buffering): Télé tries the failing ones last. Runs by itself.

actions.label: Sort the streams now
actions.description: Puts the streams of every enabled channel in order now: the available ones first, then the best quality.

actions.label: Probe one category now (test)
actions.description: Probes the next category here and now, without Celery, and shows the result: up to 30 seconds.

actions.label: Probe VOD languages now
actions.description: Starts a run at once instead of waiting for the next one. Same rules: a free connection, one probe at a time.

actions.label: Export the measured languages
actions.description: Writes the measures as test cases for Télé (names and languages only, no address).

actions.label: Forget measured languages
actions.description: Every category is probed again, for instance after a change of provider.

confirm.title: Forget the measured languages?
confirm.message: Every category will be probed again, one file at a time, when provider connections are free.
